verdict.rationale: Render's homepage states the capability almost verbatim: internal traffic stays off the public internet without VPC complexity. Its docs also reference private services, such as running ClickHouse as a private service, which supports internal-only service-to-service networking. Missing for 10: in-depth first-party docs on how private networking works (scope, regions, DNS/addressing), and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a devops-lead, I can keep internal service-to-service traffic off the public internet without VPC complexity

citations.quote: Keep internal traffic off the public internet without VPC complexity.
